prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photograph for Povod, a personal gift website. Use warm family documentary photography: observe a believable spontaneous moment, unforced expressions, and gentle natural imperfections. A couple aged 28 and 36 prepare breakfast in a small lived-in kitchen, one setting a plain plate on the counter while the other pours coffee into an unbranded ceramic mug. They exchange an affectionate smile during the ordinary shared task. Use soft morning window light and natural environmental framing with believable hands, utensils, and food. Output a wide horizontal 16:9 composition for a website section. Keep every main person and key interaction centred closely enough to remain fully inside both a central 4:3 crop and a central 1.65:1 crop; scenery may extend to the outer edges. All people are fictional and independently invented for this image; do not reproduce anyone from a reference. Give them ordinary everyday appearances, distinct faces, realistic skin pores, age-appropriate texture, and natural clothing folds. Use an understated contemporary Russian or European everyday context without national stereotypes. Use warm neutrals, paper cream, muted terracotta, and natural surrounding colours with believable exposure, without a heavy orange filter. References inform only photographic techniques and mood; create an original scene and composition. Keep faces, hands, and important gestures within the central 70 percent of the frame, with comfortable safe margins and anatomically correct fingers, limbs, eyes, and teeth. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, captions, borders, collages, grids, or contact sheets. No plastic skin, exaggerated smiles, duplicated people, extra limbs, or distorted perspective.

Distinct casting: the woman has straight shoulder-length black hair and East Asian features, and her male partner has short sandy-blond curls and a clean-shaven face. Native aspect ratio EXACTLY 16:9. Use a WIDE environmental establishing view. Both people, full heads, faces and important working hands must fit inside the CENTRAL 55 PERCENT of the image width; show uncluttered kitchen context at both edges.

FINAL COMPOSITION PRIORITY: This is a distant WIDE environmental establishing photograph from 6 metres away with natural 28mm perspective, not a close or medium group portrait. All people and their important working hands are clustered in the MIDDLE HALF of image WIDTH (horizontal coordinates 25%-75%), with complete heads inside the middle 45% of width. The LEFT QUARTER and RIGHT QUARTER show the ordinary room or workspace with no main people. Show generous surroundings, full seated or standing figures, and practical furniture. Preserve native 16:9.

Continuous real photograph from top to bottom; no gradient mask, fade, crossfade, dissolve, compositing or synthetic empty caption band. Any lower caption area consists of normal clothing, furniture, floor or real foreground objects, with coherent physical boundaries. No part of a body fades away.
review: Wide breakfast scene shows an East Asian woman setting a plate and a fair curly-haired man pouring coffee into a mug. Faces, plate grip, carafe hand and coffee stream are coherent. Both full figures and actions fit centrally with ample kitchen margins and continuous floor. Actual central 4:3 and 1.65 crops were rendered and visually checked: all main heads, key hands and actions remain complete.
